notes: Status 38 is owed for an OPEN of a FILE closed with lock (§1985:IX.1.3.4 item d), and §1985:II.2 fixes 'file' as the physical file regardless of the file-name. At --std 85 FileRegistry.CloseWithLock marks the physical file's state (PhysicalFileTable.State.ClosedWithLock) and SharedOpenAttempt asks ClosedWithLock of the state the OPEN resolves, so after CLOSE I1 WITH LOCK an OPEN INPUT, OUTPUT or I-O through a second SELECT of the same file answers 38 and a READ through it 47 (kb/Work PB5210, DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector; from 2002 the file connector is locked instead, §2002:14.8.26.3 GR24).

next.reason: 30, 35, 37 a) and 39 carry over (§2023:9.1.13.6 GR1, §2023:9.1.13.6 GR5 'is attempted on a file that is not described as optional and the physical file is not present', §2023:9.1.13.6 GR7). Two differences: 1985 d. 'I-O Status = 38 ... OPEN statement is attempted on a file previously closed with lock' has no 2023 counterpart (§2023:E.2 lists 'The WITH LOCK phrase of the CLOSE statement and the related File Status of 38' as deleted), and 37 gains a case, §2023:9.1.13.6 GR6 b) 'insufficient authority exists to access the file'. Run-time statuses only; nothing refused.
